messages:
Maya CSM: Hey team — kicking off HelixPay onboarding. High level: production pilot -> GA in 30–60d. Need to align stakeholders, success metrics, and enablement cadence. Can everyone confirm owners for infra, integration, and enablement?
Samir Solutions: I can own enablement + playbook. Recommend a 30-min workshop in week 1 for API flows + error handling.
Anjali PM: I’ll own product acceptance criteria. Proposing success metrics: 95% request completeness, avg latency < 300ms p50, key user tasks completed in first session.
Diego Eng: Eng prerequisites: SSO (SAML) + sample PII-mapped dataset + network allowlist. @Maya can you drop dataset samples and model variant we’ll benchmark?
Maya CSM: Adding assets now — uploading to shared bucket and linking the ops doc. Calendar invite pending. Link: https://redwood.team/ops/helixpay-onboard (internal).
Ruth Security: I’ll review compliance checklist. Flag: customer needs SOC2+custom DPA clause for data residency — expect 5 business days for review.
Jordan Success-ops: I'll run the enablement checklist and coordinate recordings. Suggest recording the workshop and capturing a short checklist:
```
- Intro + stakeholders
- API keys & scopes
- SSO test
- Sample request/response walkthrough
- Error modes + retry guidance
- Post-workshop feedback form link
```
Samir Solutions: 👍 love the checklist. Can we add a short lab exercise (10m) where they instrument a call and check token-level costs?
Anjali PM: Yes — include acceptance test cases: one happy path, one rate-limit recovery, one truncated response handling.
Diego Eng: For benching: request sample load script + model/quantization variants. Example command we’ll run:
```
python perf/run_client.py --host helixpay-api.redwood --threads 8 --seq 1024 --model redwood-v1-quant
```
Maya CSM: Owners so far: Enablement = Samir, Product acceptance = Anjali, Eng integration = Diego, Security/compliance = Ruth, Success ops = Jordan. I’ll own overall program and status updates.
Ruth Security: Noted. Please share any external DPA drafts with legal@redwood. I’ll expedite review if we have initial language.
Jordan Success-ops: I’ll publish a short feedback form for each workshop: 5 questions + NPS. Will share template by EOD.
Samir Solutions: Weekly sync proposed on Fridays 10am PT. If folks prefer LCT, we can rotate.
Anjali PM: Friday 10am PT works for product stakeholders.
Diego Eng: Ok for eng but prefer biweekly deep-dive in sprint windows.
Maya CSM: Agreement: weekly 30m check-ins (Fri 10am PT) + biweekly eng deep-dive. I’ll send invites for the quarter and attach the onboarding tracker.
oncall-bot: Reminder — send meeting invite with conference link set to `zoom.redwood/helixpay` and include recording enabled.
Maya CSM: Action items: 1) Samir: workshop deck + lab (due in 3 working days). 2) Diego: perf bench scripts + network checklist (due 4 working days). 3) Ruth: compliance review kickoff (due 5 bd). 4) Jordan: feedback form + recording template (due EOD). 5) Anjali: acceptance test cases (due 3 working days). I’ll follow up in #status-thread after workshop.
Samir Solutions: I’ll draft the deck and ping for a quick dry run.
Diego Eng: Dropping sample dataset link in thread after I get access to bucket.
Maya CSM: Thanks team — closing initial thread. I’ll post meeting invite in ~15m and create the tracker card in Workfront.
Jordan Success-ops: Thanks — will draft post-workshop survey.
Anjali PM: 👍
Samir Solutions: 👍
Ruth Security: 👍
